markdown.markdown:
```{r} #| label: setup #| include: false source("load data.R") ``` ## Row {height="15%} ```{r} #| content: valuebox #| title: "Total Peserta" list( icon = "people-fill", color = "primary", value = nrow(clean_sosialisasi) ) ``` ```{r} #| content: valuebox #| title: "Total Dusun" list( icon = "geo-alt-fill", color = "success", value = n_distinct(clean_sosialisasi$Dusun) ) ``` ```{r} #| content: valuebox #| title: "Total Desa" list( icon = "map-fill", color = "info", value = n_distinct(clean_sosialisasi$Desa) ) ``` ## Row {height="25%} ```{r} #| title: "Nama Pemateri Sosialisasi" clean_sosialisasi %>% group_by(`Nama Pemateri Sosialisasi`, Dusun) %>% summarise(`Jumlah Peserta` = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% arrange(desc(`Jumlah Peserta`)) %>% DT::datatable( options = list( pageLength = 5, dom = "t", scrollY = "120px" ), rownames = FALSE, style = "bootstrap4" ) ``` ## Row {height="25%"} ```{r} #| title: "Nama Pemateri Sosialisasi" clean_sosialisasi %>% group_by(`Nama Pemateri Sosialisasi`, Dusun) %>% summarise(`Jumlah Peserta` = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% arrange(desc(`Jumlah Peserta`)) %>% DT::datatable( options = list( pageLength = 5, dom = "t", scrollY = "120px" ), rownames = FALSE, style = "bootstrap4" ) ``` ## Row {height="60%"} ```{r} #| title: "Kategori Umur Peserta" df_umur <- clean_sosialisasi %>% count(`Kategori Umur`) %>% mutate( `Kategori Umur` = factor( `Kategori Umur`, levels = c("18-25", "26-35", "36-45", "46-55", "55+") ) ) %>% arrange(`Kategori Umur`) warna_umur <- scales::viridis_pal(option = "D", begin = 0.2, end = 0.9)(nrow(df_umur)) df_umur %>% plot_ly( x = ~`Kategori Umur`, y = ~n, type = "bar", marker = list(color = warna_umur) ) %>% layout( xaxis = list(title = "Kategori Umur", color = "white"), yaxis = list(title = "Jumlah Peserta", color = "white"), paper_bgcolor = "transparent", plot_bgcolor = "transparent", font = list(color = "white") ) ``` ```{r} #| title: "Distribusi Jenis Kelamin" clean_sosialisasi %>% filter(!is.na(`Jenis Kelamin`)) %>% count(`Jenis Kelamin`) %>% plot_ly( labels = ~`Jenis Kelamin`, values = ~n, type = "pie", hole = 0.4, marker = list( colors = c("#00b894", "#fdcb6e"), line = list(color = "#222222", width = 2) ), domain = list(y = c(0.15, 1)) ) %>% layout( paper_bgcolor = "transparent", plot_bgcolor = "transparent", font = list(color = "white"), legend = list( orientation = "h", xanchor = "center", yanchor = "top", x = 0.5, y = 0.05, font = list(color = "white") ) ) ``` # Penggalian Aspirasi ## Row {height="15%"} ```{r} #| content: valuebox #| title: "Total Partisipan" list( icon = "people-fill", color = "primary", value = nrow(clean_aspirasi) ) ``` ```{r} #| content: valuebox #| title: "Luas Lahan (Ha)" list( icon = "map-fill", color = "success", color = "succsess", value = round(sum(clean_aspirasi$`Luas Lahan`, na.rm = TRUE), 2) ) ``` ## Row {height="45%"} ```{r} #| title: "Jenis Insentif Diusulkan" df_insentif <- clean_aspirasi %>% filter(!is.na(`Jenis Insentif Diusulkan`)) %>% count(`Jenis Insentif Diusulkan`) %>% arrange(desc(n)) %>% mutate( `Jenis Insentif Diusulkan` = factor( `Jenis Insentif Diusulkan`, levels = `Jenis Insentif Diusulkan` ) ) warna_insentif <- scales::viridis_pal(option = "G", begin = 0.3, end = 0.9)(nrow(df_insentif)) df_insentif %>% plot_ly( x = ~`Jenis Insentif Diusulkan`, y = ~n, type = "bar", marker = list(color = warna_insentif) ) %>% layout( xaxis = list( title = "", color = "white", tickangle = 0 ), yaxis = list(title = "Jumlah", color = "white"), paper_bgcolor = "transparent", plot_bgcolor = "transparent", font = list(color = "white"), margin = list(b = 140) ) ``` ```{r} #| title: "Distribusi per Dusun" df_dusun <- clean_aspirasi %>% filter(!is.na(Dusun)) %>% count(Dusun) %>% arrange(desc(n)) warna_dusun <- scales::viridis_pal(option = "D", begin = 0.2, end = 0.85)(nrow(df_dusun)) df_dusun %>% plot_ly( labels = ~Dusun, values = ~n, type = "pie", hole = 0.4, marker = list( colors = warna_dusun, line = list(color = "#222222", width = 2) ), domain = list(y = c(0.15, 1)) ) %>% layout( paper_bgcolor = "transparent", plot_bgcolor = "transparent", font = list(color = "white"), legend = list( orientation = "h", xanchor = "center", x = 0.5, y = 0.05, font = list(color = "white") ) ) ``` ## Row {height="40%"} ```{r} #| title: "Detail Penggalian Aspirasi" clean_aspirasi %>% select(Tanggal, `Nama Pemberi Aspirasi`, Dusun, Desa, `Jenis Insentif Diusulkan`, `Luas Lahan`, Keterangan) %>% DT::datatable( options = list( pageLength = 5, dom = "tp", scrollX = TRUE, columnDefs = list( list(width = '110px', targets = 0), list(width = '150px', targets = 1), list(width = '200px', targets = 4) ) ), rownames = FALSE, style = "bootstrap4" ) ``` # Jadwal Bakar ## Row {height="20%"} ```{r} #| content: valuebox #| title: "Jadwal Bakar" list( icon = "calendar2-check-fill", color = "warning", value = nrow(clean_jadwalmembakar) ) ``` ```{r} #| content: valuebox #| title: "Desa" list( icon = "map-fill", color = "danger", value = n_distinct(clean_jadwalmembakar$Desa) ) ``` ```{r} #| content: valuebox #| title: "Dusun" list( icon = "geo-alt-fill", color = "primary", value = n_distinct(clean_jadwalmembakar$Dusun) ) ``` ## Row {height="40%"} ```{r} #| title: "Intensitas Rencana Pembakaran per Desa" df_jadwal_desa <- clean_jadwalmembakar %>% filter(!is.na(Desa)) %>% count(Desa) %>% arrange(desc(n)) warna_jadwal <- scales::viridis_pal(option = "D", begin = 0.2, end = 0.9)(nrow(df_jadwal_desa)) df_jadwal_desa %>% plot_ly( x = ~factor(Desa, levels = Desa), y = ~n, type = "bar", marker = list(color = warna_jadwal) ) %>% layout( xaxis = list(title = "", color = "white", tickangle = 0), yaxis = list(title = "Jumlah Jadwal", color = "white"), paper_bgcolor = "transparent", plot_bgcolor = "transparent", font = list(color = "white"), margin = list(b = 60) ) ``` ```{r} #| title: "Intensitas Rencana Pembakaran per Bulan" df_bulan_bakar <- clean_jadwalmembakar %>% filter(!is.na(`Tanggal Pembakaran Lahan`)) %>% mutate(Bulan = format(`Tanggal Pembakaran Lahan`, "%b %Y")) %>% count(Bulan) %>% arrange(ymd(paste0("01 ", Bulan))) warna_bulan_bakar <- scales::viridis_pal(option = "E", begin = 0.2, end = 0.9)(nrow(df_bulan_bakar)) df_bulan_bakar %>% plot_ly( x = ~factor(Bulan, levels = Bulan), y = ~n, type = "bar", marker = list(color = warna_bulan_bakar) ) %>% layout( xaxis = list(title = "", color = "white", tickangle = 0), yaxis = list(title = "Jumlah Jadwal", color = "white"), paper_bgcolor = "transparent", plot_bgcolor = "transparent", font = list(color = "white"), margin = list(b = 60) ) ``` ## Row {height="40%"} ```{r} #| title: "Jadwal Pembakaran Lahan Masyarakat" clean_jadwalmembakar %>% DT::datatable( options = list( pageLength = 5, dom = "ftip", scrollX = TRUE ), rownames = FALSE, style = "bootstrap4" ) ``` # Hostpot & Aktivitas Membakar ## Row {height="20%"} ```{r} #| content: valuebox #| title: "Titik Hotspot" list( icon = "fire", color = "danger", value = nrow(clean_hotspot %>% filter(`Tipe Insiden` == "Kebakaran lahan (hotspot)")) ) ``` ```{r} #| content: valuebox #| title: "Dibakar & Dijaga" list( icon = "shield-check", color = "success", value = nrow(clean_hotspot %>% filter(`Tipe Insiden` == "Sudah dibakar & dijaga (non-hotspot)")) ) ``` ```{r} #| content: valuebox #| title: "Desa Terdampak" list( icon = "map-fill", color = "warning", value = n_distinct(clean_hotspot$Desa) ) ``` ## Row {height="85%"} ```{r} #| title: "Peta Sebaran Titik Insiden & Aktivitas Pembakaran" library(leaflet) pal_peta <- colorFactor( palette = c("#ff7675", "#00b894"), domain = clean_hotspot$`Tipe Insiden` ) clean_hotspot %>% filter(!is.na(Longitude) & !is.na(Latitude)) %>% leaflet() %>% addTiles() %>% addCircleMarkers( lng = ~Longitude, lat = ~Latitude, radius = 7, color = ~pal_peta(`Tipe Insiden`), stroke = TRUE, weight = 1.5, fillOpacity = 0.85, popup = ~paste0( "
", "Desa: ", Desa, "
", "Dusun: ", Dusun, "
", "Tipe Insiden: ", `Tipe Insiden`, "
", "Nama Pemilik Lahan: ", `Nama Pemilik Lahan`, "
", "Tanggal: ", Tanggal, "
", "Luas Terbakar (Ha): ", `Luas Terbakar (Ha)`, " Ha
", "Keterangan: ", Keterangan, "
" ) ) %>% addLegend( position = "bottomright", pal = pal_peta, values = ~`Tipe Insiden`, title = "Kategori Insiden", opacity = 0.9 ) ```
